senses.gloss: m.(b. h. מֹחַ; מחח , v. מָהָה) marrow, esp. (with or without ראש) brain.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 6:10">Tosef. Pes. VI, 10</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00346"><he>קוּלִית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite> <he>קרום של מ׳</he> the membrane which surrounds the brain, v. <he>חַיִּיתָא</he> IV.
Ib. 45ᵃ מ׳ כל מה … מ׳ as to moaḥ, whatever is contained in the skull is considered as brain.
<cite ref="Chullin 45b:15">Ib. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>רוב מוֹחוֹ</he> the larger part of the marrow of the spine (spinal cord); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Menachot 80b:14">Men. 80ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 9a:19">Yeb. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>אין לו מ׳ בקדקדו</he> has no brains in his head.
